The '''Prototype battle droids''' that [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], and a group of other Jedi encountered on [[Radnor/Legends|Radnor]] had no official designation. Created by the company owned by the famed weapon designer [[Galen (Radnoran)|Galen]] and his sister [[Curi]], they were similar to the [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]]s that were ubiquitous around the galaxy at the time. However, they had better armor and their targeting systems were much more accurate. Like the B1 battle droids, they could be transported in [[Multi-Troop Transport/Legends|Multi-Troop Transports]]. Galen, after releasing a deadly toxin on his home planet, gave the ambassador to [[Avon]] the control codes to his droids.
